//: Per-ticker icon overrides for AssetIcon, consumed by resolveIconCandidates
in src/utils/websiteIcon.js. The default fallback order is Brandfetch (by
ticker), then Google's favicon-by-domain, then (if set here) a locally
hosted SVG. Add an entry keyed by ticker (uppercase) using either field
below; unset fields are omitted, not null.
website: "https://example.com" — overrides the domain the Google-favicon
fallback uses. Use this when the ticker's profile website is wrong/
unhelpful for a favicon (e.g. GOOGL's yfinance website is a shared
source: "/icons/TICKER.svg" — a locally hosted SVG under frontend/public,
tried last, after both Brandfetch and Google. Use this only when neither
automated provider serves a usable icon for that ticker.
